epics.title: Game Creation and Management
epics.description: This epic covers the functionalities required for moderators to create, manage, and modify games. It allows moderators to start new games, manage items to be estimated, and invite participants effectively.

user_stories.title: Create a New Game
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators.

user_stories.title: Invite Estimators
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game, so that we can start the game.

user_stories.title: Add Item for Estimation
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated, so that we can be flexible and accommodate situations where we think of a new story while playing.

user_stories.title: Edit Item for Estimation
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to edit an item in the list of items to be estimated, so that I can make it better reflect the team's understanding of the item.

user_stories.title: Delete Item from Estimation
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to delete an item from the list of items to be estimated, so that we can remove it and not estimate it.

user_stories.title: View All Items for Estimation
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session, so that I can answer questions about the current story such as 'does this include ___'.

user_stories.title: Select Item for Estimation
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated, so that the team sees that item and can estimate it.

user_stories.title: Show Estimates Immediately
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately, so that I can decide to show the estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate.

user_stories.title: Accept Average Estimate
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to accept the average of all estimates, so that we can move on to the next item when we agree.

user_stories.title: Automatically Fill Estimate Field
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to have the 'estimate' field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card, so that I can accept it more quickly.

user_stories.title: Enter Agreed-Upon Estimate
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to enter the agreed-upon estimate, so that we can move on to the next item when we agree.

user_stories.title: Re-estimate Previous Story
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again, so that we can give a new estimate if we feel different about the story after estimating other related stories.

user_stories.title: Import Stories from Spreadsheet
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet, so that I don't have to copy and paste each individual story.

user_stories.title: Copy/Paste Stories from Spreadsheet
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet, so that I can get started more quickly.

user_stories.title: Browse Previous Games
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to browse through previous games, so that I can find the previous game I'm looking for.

user_stories.title: View Game Transcript
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to view a transcript of a game, so that I can see the stories and estimates.

user_stories.title: Export Game Transcript as HTML
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as an HTML file, so that I can save the stories and estimates locally.

user_stories.title: Export Game Transcript as CSV
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file, so that I can further process the stories and estimates.

user_stories.title: Delete a Game
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored.

epics.title: Account Management
epics.description: This epic provides functionalities related to user account management, allowing moderators to create, log in, modify, and delete their accounts securely.

user_stories.title: Create an Account
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password, and a username, so that I can start using the application.

user_stories.title: Log In to Account
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to log in using my account name and password, so that I can start using the application.

user_stories.title: Change Account Details
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to change my account details, so that I can keep my account details up-to-date.

user_stories.title: Delete My Account
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored.

user_stories.title: Get Password Reminder
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to get a password reminder by email, so that I can get back to using the application when I've forgotten my password.

epics.title: Time and Estimation Settings
epics.description: This epic enables moderators to manage time settings and estimation configurations to suit the needs of their teams during estimation sessions.

user_stories.title: View Local Timezone
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to see dates and times in my local timezone, so that I don't have to do timezone conversion myself.

user_stories.title: Select Estimation Scale
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}, so that the team can use either the modified Fibonacci sequence or powers of 2.

user_stories.title: Invite Up to 15 Estimators
user_stories.story: As a moderator, I want to invite up to 15 estimators, so that we can play with large but not immense teams.

epics.title: Estimator Participation
epics.description: This epic encompasses functionalities for estimators to participate in games, including submitting estimates and viewing relevant information about the items being estimated.

user_stories.title: Join a Game
user_stories.story: As an estimator, I want to join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for, so that I can participate.

user_stories.title: View Item Being Estimated
user_stories.story: As an estimator, I want to see the item we’re estimating, so that I know what I’m giving an estimate for.

user_stories.title: See All Items for Estimation
user_stories.story: As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate this session, so that I have a feel for the sizes of the various items.

user_stories.title: See Who Gave Estimates
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to see who gave what estimates during the current round, so that I know this when we’re discussing the estimates.

user_stories.title: See Estimate Notifications
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator, so that I know who has already given an estimate and who we’re still waiting for.

user_stories.title: View Prior Estimates
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated, so that I can see how his or her opinion has changed so I can ask questions.

user_stories.title: Change Estimate Until Last Card Selected
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed, so that I can change my mind.

user_stories.title: Change Estimate Up Until Last Person Selects
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown, so that I can change my mind based on information I hear.

user_stories.title: Start a Countdown Timer
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to be able to start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see, so that I can limit the time spent discussing the estimates when I think we’ve talked long enough.

user_stories.title: Reset Timer After Estimate
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate, so that it's ready for use on the next round.

user_stories.title: Scroll Through Previous Estimates
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds, so that I can use this information when I estimate the item of the current round.

user_stories.title: Display Thumbnail Photo
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played, so that the game is more personal because I see who I'm estimating with.

user_stories.title: Keep Card Order Consistent
user_stories.story: As a participant, I want to always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws, so that it's easy to compare estimates.

epics.title: Development Standards
epics.description: This epic focuses on development standards and practices to ensure that the application is user-friendly, accessible, and performant.

user_stories.title: Compliance with XHTML and CSS Standards
user_stories.story: As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards, so that as many people as possible can access the site and view it as intended.

user_stories.title: Create Database Indexes
user_stories.story: As a developer, I want to have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible.

user_stories.title: Functionality Across Browsers
user_stories.story: As a developer, I want to have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2, so that as many people as possible can fully use the application.

user_stories.title: W3C Accessibility Compliance
user_stories.story: As a developer, I want to have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible, so that people with accessibility issues can use the application.

user_stories.title: Fast Application Response
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to have the application respond quickly to my actions, so that I don't get bored.

user_stories.title: Unicode Support
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to be able to use Unicode, so that I can use any language I like.

user_stories.title: Sensible and Predictable URLs
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to see sensible and predictable URLs, so that the application feels logical and transparent.

user_stories.title: User-Friendly Error Pages
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong, so that I can trust the system and its developers.

user_stories.title: Non-Identifiable Data Storage
user_stories.story: As a Researcher, I want results to be stored in a non-identifiable way, so that I can study the data to see things like whether estimates converged around the first opinion given by 'estimator A'.
